test_title: PYST 6: SSC JE EE - Reasoning (Held on: 24 March 2021 (Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the word-pair in which the two words are related in the same way as are the two words in the following word-pair.

Satellite : Space
solution:
Satellites are used in Space.

Similarly,

Submarines are used in Sea.

Hence, ‘Submarine : Sea’ is the correct answer.
